name: @cogito.ai/template-skills-registry
description: Public Agent Skills content registry — a git repo of skills/<name>/SKILL.md canon plus a generated skills.json manifest, a Fumadocs site, and three day-one CI gates (full validation, manifest freshness, public/private boundary).
